verdict.rationale: Pulley claims native e-signature, including collecting board member signatures alongside investor signatures for SAFEs without a third-party tool (pulley-docs-9, pulley-docs-33). It lists 'board management' within its compliance suite (pulley-docs-19) and can attach uploaded documents to specific securities (pulley-docs-1), which loosely covers archiving against transactions. missing for 10: explicit board consent and stockholder approval drafting or templates, documented routing workflows for governance approvals, explicit linking of approvals to the transactions they authorize, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
